summary: The revision establishes a compact sandwich-layout concept and the four principal component envelopes, but key production interfaces remain unresolved. Rear I/O, cooler intake clearance, GPU bracket/riser/cable space, PSU retention/inlet/airflow/cabling, and power-button routing are not visually established; the SFX integration view shows major missing manufacturing details.

checks.description: The shell, central spine, motherboard, cooler, GPU, and SFX reference form a coherent compact sandwich-layout concept with no visibly floating reference body or missing primary structural shell in the reviewed views.

evidence.description: The isometric view visibly presents the complete shell, spine, and internal reference-envelope arrangement as one coherent assembly concept.

checks.description: A Mini-ITX board envelope is visible, but these views do not establish mounting-hole retention hardware or a defined accessible rear-I/O opening.

evidence.description: The board-sized internal reference is visible, but mounting features and a rear-I/O interface cannot be directly confirmed.

checks.description: The cooler envelope is represented, but the reviewed images do not directly prove preserved side-panel intake clearance or a ventilated side-panel interface.

evidence.description: The cooler region can be seen in the stacked layout, but no measurable or visibly open intake gap to a side panel is established.

checks.description: The compact GPU envelope is present, but the GPU I/O bracket, PCIe riser path, and power-cable bend volume are not visibly modeled well enough to verify the complete interface.

evidence.description: A GPU-sized envelope is visible in the sandwich layout, while its bracket, riser, and cable-routing interfaces are not directly shown.

checks.description: A standard SFX-sized reference is visibly included, but retention, AC inlet access, airflow openings, and cable-routing/bend space are not established by the available views.

evidence.description: The PSU envelope is visible inside the structural frame, but no complete mounting, inlet, ventilation, or cable interface is visible.

checks.description: No externally accessible power button or corresponding internal route to the motherboard header is visible on the concept shell.

evidence.description: The visible exterior shell faces contain no identifiable power-button feature or routing provision.

checks.description: The focused views clearly show an SFX reference envelope, but visual evidence alone cannot establish that no hidden Flex ATX/1U reference object remains anywhere in the revision.

evidence.description: The focused isometric view directly shows the SFX reference envelope, but cannot prove the global absence of every alternative PSU reference.

checks.description: The concept layout visibly expresses all four requested reference envelopes: Mini-ITX motherboard, AXP120-X67 cooler, compact GPU, and SFX PSU.

evidence.description: The focused isometric view visibly presents the four component-envelope bodies together in the current sandwich layout.
The top view confirms the distinct plan footprints and simultaneous placement of the component references.

checks.description: The concept shell remains within the 4.0 L bounding-envelope target: supporting geometry reports 185 x 178 x 120 mm, approximately 3.95 L. The reviewed views show dense adjacency around the SFX and other envelopes, so integration clearance remains a visible risk despite meeting the gross volume target.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows the compact shell containing the major reference envelopes and visibly illustrates the tight SFX adjacency that remains an integration risk.
The top view directly shows the tightly packed plan arrangement within the shell footprint.

checks.description: The SFX reference is only an envelope within a basic frame: dedicated retention features, an AC inlet cutout, defined intake/exhaust openings, and explicit cable-bend/routing volume are visibly absent from the rear/right-side concept views.

evidence.description: The rear isometric view shows a plain PSU envelope and surrounding shell without identifiable SFX brackets, inlet geometry, ventilation pattern, or reserved cable path.
The back view visibly lacks a defined AC inlet and PSU exhaust/access cutout, confirming unresolved rear integration.
